newsitem.title: FRANCE: Matif, SBF join forces on equity futures contracts.
newsitem.headline: Matif, SBF join forces on equity futures contracts.

text.p: The French Matif and SBF market authorities said on Friday they are setting up a joint company to manage and expand a range of new futures contracts using equity market indices.

The contracts will be based on the CAC-40 index as well projected industry and European indices, the financial futures and options exchange Matif SA and stock markets association SBF said in a joint statement.
They said they aimed to create an integrated line of products, ranging from equities to related derivatives, including options and futures on indices, and harmonise systems and procedures.

They would seek to cut trading costs for members and clients, facilitate cross-hedging positions in all equity products and their derivatives, notably by market makers and arbitrageurs, and increase liquidity, the statement said.
The SBF (Societe des Bourses Francaises) will be in charge of floor trading in CAC-40 index futures as of spring 1997 and take over related clearing operations in 1998.
"The two market operators will work together to promote the new products to their clients and distribution networks..." the statement said. (( -- Paris newsroom +33 1 4221 5452 ))
